plan.scope: Owner-authorized bounded two-Story LLC search usability pilot from existing approved UX scope. Presentation-only, synthetic data. Existing search results/navigation must remain identical. Read CLAUDE.md and mapped design specifications; owner baseline main 0710e5188ba52199eb230be01c0289ec07bba902 supersedes historical migration branch hints. No edits to domain, storage, schema, auth, security, dependencies or accounting. Add meaningful component-level tests with vitest and existing react-dom/server; mock RN only at the host boundary. Test real rendered components/handlers, not source strings. Native platform acceptance remains a separate required coordinator check; never claim VoiceOver/TalkBack acceptance from props. Do not update progress docs: coordinator owns those.
